newsitem.title: SPAIN: Sweden issues five-year 15 bln pta matador bond.
newsitem.headline: Sweden issues five-year 15 bln pta matador bond.

text.p: The Kingdom of Sweden has issued a five-year matador bond for 15 billion pesetas in six tranches, lead manager Argentaria Banco de Negocios said on Thursday.
Each tranche is for 2.5 billion pesetas. The deal matures on December 15, 2002 and the payment date is June 30 1997.
Lead manager Argentaria said each tranche would pay the following coupons: first 4.48 percent, second 4.49 percent, third 4.495 percent, fourth 4.505 percent, fifth 4.51 percent, sixth 4.52 percent.
Repayment will be at 108.65 plus a spread to peseta Libor.
